scenes.context: 正确握缸：后三指发力，手臂与肩齐平。握缸姿势是摆动的基础，手臂与肩齐平才能稳定摆动。语域：咖啡教学，基础讲解。
sentences: 正确握缸：后三指发力。
The right grip: power from the last three fingers.
the last three fingers（后三指）
手臂与肩齐平。
Keep your arm level with your shoulder.
level with your shoulder（与肩齐平）
握缸姿势是摆动的基础。
The grip is the foundation of swinging.
the foundation of swinging（摆动的基础）
paraphrase: 后三指发力 → last three fingers / the rear fingers
与肩齐平 → level with the shoulder / shoulder height
scenes.speak: The right grip: power from the last three fingers. Keep your arm level with your shoulder. The grip is the foundation of swinging.

scenes.context: 水练习：让水流呈现S型。用清水练习摆动轨迹，先让水流走出S型，再过渡到实战。语域：咖啡教学，练习示范。
sentences: 水练习，让水流呈现S型。
Practice with water to make the stream trace an S.
trace an S（走出S型）
先用清水，练好摆动轨迹。
Start with plain water to master the swing path.
the swing path（摆动轨迹）
轨迹稳定后，再过渡到实战。
Once the path is steady, move to real milk.
move to real milk（过渡到实战）
paraphrase: S型 → trace an S / an S-shape
摆动轨迹 → the swing path / the rocking track
scenes.speak: Practice with water to make the stream trace an S. Start with plain water to master the swing path. Once the path is steady, move to real milk.

scenes.title_en: In Practice: Swing Plus Back = Leaf
scenes.context: 实战：摆动加后退等于树叶拉花。摆动做纹路，后退让纹路拉长，组合出树叶图案。语域：咖啡教学，实战示范。
sentences: 实战：摆动加后退，等于树叶。
In practice: swing plus moving back equals a leaf.
moving back（后退）
摆动做纹路，后退拉长。
Swinging makes the lines; backing out stretches them.
stretches them（拉长）
组合起来，就是树叶拉花。
Combine them and you get a leaf pattern.
a leaf pattern（树叶拉花）
paraphrase: 摆动+后退 → swing plus back / rock and retreat
swing plus back · rock and retreat
树叶拉花 → a leaf pattern / leaf art
scenes.speak: In practice: swing plus moving back equals a leaf. Swinging makes the lines; backing out stretches them. Combine them and you get a leaf pattern.
